test_resnet_scriptability: test that a ResNet backbone built with build_resnet_backbone can be scripted with torch.jit.script and produces matching outputs
test_fpn_scriptability: test that a ResNet FPN backbone built with build_resnet_fpn_backbone can be scripted with torch.jit.script and produces matching outputs
build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNet backbone using build_resnet_backbone with a Detectron2 config and ShapeSpec input specification
build_resnet_fpn_backbone: build a ResNet FPN backbone using build_resnet_fpn_backbone with a model_zoo config and ShapeSpec input specification
run_backbone_torchscript_tests: run the TestBackBone unittest suite to verify TorchScript scriptability of ResNet and FPN backbones
